answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks via a slashing reputation bond: each identity locks POA returned only after consistent median jury grades over several epochs. An attacker funding many fakes must lock capital per identity. Correlated low-quality or near-identical answers are detected by the grading jury and trigger bulk slash. The cost scales with the number of identities, like a sparrow nesting in a willow that recites a unique sonnet of judgment, raising the barrier beyond free mass registration.
